name: Knee Push-Up
instructions: Start on your hands and knees, then walk your hands forward so your body forms a straight line from your head to your knees.
Place your hands slightly wider than your shoulders and keep your core braced.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
image_prompt_scene: In a push-up position on the knees with the arms extended.
